verdict.rationale: vLLM documents continuous batching of incoming requests and an offline inference mode, which process many prompts together. This is mainly engine-level throughput scheduling rather than a documented user-facing bulk-operation interface. A community user also reports adding their own explicit batching in the client and a central queue on top of vLLM. missing for 10: documented user-facing batch/bulk submission API (e.g., batch job endpoint or list-of-prompts offline API details), bulk result handling, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
